title: A Pangolin's Tongue Is Rooted Near Its Hips and Reaches 40 cm
subject: pangolin

scenes.text: A pangolin's tongue starts near its hips.
It has no teeth, so its tongue does all the work.
The tongue is anchored near the last ribs and the pelvis.
Fully stretched, it can reach over 40 centimeters, longer than its head and body combined.
It pokes it deep into ant nests and pulls out thousands of ants.
A tongue that starts at the hips. Now watch it again.

description:
A pangolin's tongue is rooted near its pelvis, not its mouth.
It can stretch past 40 centimeters, longer than its head and body combined, to reach deep into ant nests.
What other animal has a strange tongue?
first_comment: Pangolin scales are keratin, like fingernails, and make up about 20 percent of their weight. Which strange animal next?
